intro: A fairly quiet Monday window. Reddit search feeds were rate-limited this morning, so the Reddit section only has two posts.

must_reads.title: Marketplace Universe News 26.10.2026 – ChatGPT gets a buy box, AliExpress taps YouTube’s creators
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: AliExpress is bringing its YouTube affiliate tie-up to the UK, US, Germany and Brazil, so creators can tag AliExpress products right inside YouTube Studio. Platforms keep building their own in-app affiliate links, store by store, which makes it more valuable to have one link that works across every store and platform.

must_reads.title: Amazon Brings Shoppable Product Tagging to YouTube, Pinterest for Indian Creators
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Amazon is letting Indian creators tag Amazon products on YouTube and Pinterest. Amazon and the platforms are working together to keep shopping inside their own walls, a trend that keeps shrinking the space for plain outbound links.

must_reads.title: Rest of World’s funding crisis exposes the AI-driven collapse of referral traffic
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: A well-known newsroom may close partly because Google's AI answers send it far fewer visitors. Less search traffic means content sites, including affiliate sites, need more value from every click they still get.

must_reads.title: In Graphic Detail: What Apple’s identity block means for the ad money
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Apple's Safari now blocks companies that track people across sites. Cross-site tracking keeps getting harder, so first-party data like your own link clicks becomes more important.

must_reads.title: QVC Plans TikTok Mega Lives for Black Friday and Cyber Monday
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: QVC is planning eight to ten hour TikTok livestreams for Black Friday. Live shopping is becoming a big holiday sales channel, and those sales happen inside the app rather than through links.
